issue_summary.TYPE_CHECK: Technical replicate indices, the right field.

issue_summary.TRUTH_CHECK: The runs are not repeated measurements of the same material, but rather different materials (different enzyme digestions) from the same biological sample. According to the field definition, separate elutions or enrichment steps (or in this case, separate enzymatic digestions) are fractions, not technical replicates.
issue_summary.COMPLETENESS_CHECK: The mapping assigns index 1 to all runs, but the logic is wrong because these are fractions.
